content:
Hey! Built a small game teaching number theory (divisibility → congruences → GCD/Bézout → linear congruences & CRT).
Heads up: I'm not a mathematician or teacher, and I used AI for some of the hint/intro text. Proofs are all Lean-checked, but the wording might have rough spots — please call them out.
https://github.com/k88-b/NumberTheoryGame
https://adam.math.hhu.de/#/g/k88-b/NumberTheoryGame
